0022600003.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Oklahoma City Thunder on the road in San Antonio. The Thunder are without Nikola Topic (back surgery), Otega Oweh (Achilles surgery), and Thomas Sorber (knee surgery), and Cason Wallace is day-to-day for an undisclosed reason and a game-time decision, while the Spurs are missing Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The Thunder lost the 2025-26 season series 1-4 and their 2025-26 playoff series 3-4, most recently falling 111-103 in Oklahoma City on May 30, 2026. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Thunder a 45% chance of winning.
